observed_facts: 深色普通字母样注记位于中央四足图形腿部下方，与外围浅色伏尼契样书写层外观不同。
外扩与场景视图显示：注记上方竖向彩色/淡色形状可追到动物腿，字迹与腿端在局部紧贴或叠压；没有可分离的、从文字另行出发的完整引线。
原紧框切到上方/左端部分笔迹；本补查不据外扩图重新认证完整字串，也不把腿延长线自动当文字连接。

observed_endpoint_facts: Compact dark writing lies directly under the central colored quadruped's feet, inside the innermost course. No other body occupies this central compartment. Several leg-end and writing strokes approach or overlap; contact requires separate endpoint qualification and does not itself certify naming.

Tight native endpoint inspection retains a partial graphic-contact candidate: Colored/dark leg-end contours meet or overlap the writing beneath the feet; foot versus writing ink boundary is unresolved, not a distinct label leader.
original_candidate_edges_preserved.crossing_resolution: Colored/dark leg-end contours meet or overlap the writing beneath the feet; foot versus writing ink boundary is unresolved, not a distinct label leader.
limitations: Layout candidate is not a word/name/semantic ownership claim. Candidate body and pointed components can belong to one graphical complex; array size is not a count of alternative persons.
